nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bản thân & gia đình · bài tự soạn
title: Family chat · Sunday lunch
L: Mom: Grandma is coming over on Sunday, so please keep the afternoon free.
Dad: Sounds good! I'll pick her up from the bus station at ten.
Lan: I can help Mom cook. Should I make the spring rolls?
Mom: Yes, please. And Nam, can you set the table at noon?
Nam: No problem, but I might be a bit late. I have football until eleven.
Dad: Okay, just text us when you're on your way.
Mom: Can't wait! It's been two months since we last saw her.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: Grandma is coming over on Sunday, so please keep the afternoon ___.
exq.why: keep + danh từ + free (tính từ) = để trống, không hẹn việc khác.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: Sounds good! I'll ___ her up from the bus station at ten.
exq.why: pick sb up = đón ai; take / get / bring her up không có nghĩa đón.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: I can help Mom cook. ___ I make the spring rolls?
exq.why: Should I + V? = Con có nên … không?

exq.q: Chỗ trống 4: I might be a bit late. I have football ___ eleven.
exq.why: until + giờ = cho đến lúc đó (bóng đá kéo dài tới 11 giờ).

exq.q: Who will go to the bus station?
exq.why: Dad: “I’ll pick her up from the bus station at ten.”
